spatial_reference.name: SIRGAS 2000
spatial_reference.rule: Source CRS is preserved in provenance/asset metadata. Canonical national vector geometries are normalized to SRID 4674 without simplifying the authoritative shape.
spatial_reference.metric_rule: Area/distance calculations must use an appropriate projected CRS/geography method; never treat angular coordinates as meters.

ld_catalog.purpose: Sources, connectors, immutable snapshots and normalized upstream records.

ld_evidence.purpose: Property-level facts, derived lineage and explicit unknowns.

ld_domain.purpose: Typed normalized datasets used for spatial/legal/fiscal queries.

ld_api.purpose: Public-safe read-model foundation only; HTTP API comes later.

invariants: Every normalized domain row must reference ld_catalog.normalized_record.
Every normalized_record must reference an immutable snapshot and source.
Fiscal unit, parcel, building, condominium unit and registry reference remain distinct subjects/identifiers.
No owner/person name or CPF/CNPJ is required by the public schema.
L4 registry documents/ownership/encumbrances are intentionally excluded from the public database schema.
Assertions marked AVAILABLE require a value.
DERIVED_ANALYSIS requires a method and DERIVED access class; lineage connects upstream assertions.
Unknown facts are stored explicitly with reason and next_action.
Public API view exposes only assertions with public_release_allowed=true and a public-safe access class.
Utility status distinguishes provider territory/network context from technical availability.
Heritage status distinguishes tombed, pending, surrounding area, protected area and archaeological status.
Temporal fields are append/version oriented; new snapshots/versions must not silently overwrite history.
Raw bytes belong in object storage; PostgreSQL stores manifest/hash/object key and normalized records.

excluded_from_public_schema: CPF/CNPJ associated with private ownership or applicant identity
private_data_boundary.future_storage: Separate private/restricted store and authorization boundary for L4, linked only by opaque references when needed.
